title: Display of downed Detachment H U-2s in Peiping, with TACKLE peripheral missions table
description: Black-and-white photograph of aircraft wreckage laid out in a public plaza before a large building, with crowds of onlookers, captioned "Display of downed detachment H U-2s in Peiping." Below is a small table, "Project TACKLE Peripheral Missions, 1969-1974," listing missions by fiscal year (1969: 9; 1970: 14; 1971: 19; 1972: 23; 1973: 31; 1974: 17). Chapter 5 text (page 245) notes increased restrictions on U-2 missions after the announcement of Nixon's visit to the PRC.
